rationale: WarmupLR hardcoded warmup_max_lr=0.001 instead of inheriting optimizer's configured lr. After warmup completes, scheduler lr must equal optimizer's configured lr. Single-rank, single-field check; no cross-rank compare and no module-attr guard needed -> schema_only. Pattern P1 because lr (Tier 3 trace field) has a deterministic expected value from config. Borderline value_equality vs implementation_equivalence (anti-example 11): chose value_equality because the expected value is a known config constant (0.005), not the output of a reference scheduler implementation.
